courses.description: Through an introductory survey of the basic theories in Chinese medicine, topics like theories of yin-yang, vital activities of the body, meridians, viscera and bowels, causes and mechanisms of diseases, methods of diagnosis, as well as the principles and methods of treatment will be dealt with.
courses.learning_outcomes:
本课程属于中医专业的基础课程。通过本课程的学习，要求同学掌握中医学的哲学基础、中医学对正常人体的认识及治疗原则，为日后同学学习中医诊断学、中药学、方剂学和中医临床各科打好基础。

1. 理解并掌握中医基础理论与中国传统哲学之间的关系，能运用元气论、阴阳理论及五行理论认识一般的自然现象与天人合一的原理；理解传统中医学中特有的思维方法，并能将其运用于日常生活与健康相关活动中。

2. 理解并掌握中医基础理论中的基本概念与理论，如藏象、气血、经络、病因、病机、治则等，并能用来解释一般的生命现象。

3. 正确认识中医的疾病观，能运用邪正盛衰、阴阳失调、气血失常理论来解释基本的发病原理，并能指出疾病过程中寒热转化、虚实转化的具体规律。

4. 理解中医治疗疾病的基本原则，并能解释“三因制宜”的运用原理。

courses.description: The aim of this course is to provide students with a basic knowledge of human topographical anatomy with particular emphasis on those aspects of special significance in Chinese Medicine, including Acupuncture, Tui-na and Orthopaedics and Traumatology in Chinese Medicine. The course will run concurrently with that in physiology and the syllabus will be integrated so that students will be able to correlate structure and function.
courses.learning_outcomes:
By the end of the course, students are able to:
1. Familiarize with the general organization of the organs in the body and how they organize to form a functional system.
2. Learn the importance of the structural relationship and arrangement in the clinical setting.
3. Be able to describe both the macroscopic and microscopic structures of the organs, and relate them to the functions of the organs.

courses.description: This course will cover the general physiology of humans, with an objective of enhancing thestudents' knowledge and understanding of how the body adapts physiologically to internal and external environmental changes. Topics include the physiological principles of normal cells, tissues and systems of the body. Comparisons with the concepts in Chinese medicine will be highlighted.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCME Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
1. Understand the electrical properties of a neuron and understand the physiological significance of conduction of nerve impulse.
2. Recognize how a skeletal muscle contracts and recall the importance of neuromuscular transmission in a human body.
3. Describe with examples how homeostasis helps maintain physiological functions such as thermoregulation.
4. Discuss how the cardiovascular system helps regulate blood perfusion in body tissues.
5. Summarize how some of the altered functions in the cardiovascular and pulmonary systems affect the body.
6. Explain how the pulmonary system and blood transport oxygen to tissues and carbon dioxide from the tissues.
7. Summarize the roles of blood in hemostasis and immune defense.

courses.description: Methodologies of Diagnosis in Chinese Medicine is a subject about the fundamental theories, basic knowledge and skills concerning how to collect clinical information, diagnose diseases and differentiate patterns based on the basic theories of Chinese medicine. This module acts as a bridge linking the fundamental theories and various clinical subjects in Chinese medicine, and thus remains as one of the key components within the framework of Chinese medicine’s specialties. Through the studies of this course, the students will be able to master the basic theories, fundamental knowledge and skills concerning the four diagnostic methods in Chinese medicine including observation, olfaction and auscultation, inquiring and palpation. Upon the completion of the course, the students will be capable of making clinical diagnosis using common pattern differentiation methods encompassing eight rubrics, etiology & qi, blood and body fluids, visceral differentiations. In addition, the students will be familiar with six channels differentiation, wei-qi-ying-xue differentiation, sanjiao differentiation and meridian differentiation methods. Emphasis will be placed on the training students’ practical skills in four diagnostic methods, differentiating clinical patterns and writing clinical case notes, so that the course will lay a solid foundation for future studies of clinical subjects. The module Basic Concepts in Chinese Medicine is a pre-requisite for this course.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCM Majors only; Prerequisite: BCME1205.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本課程後，學生們將能達到以下的學習成果：
（一）知識方面：
1. 掌握中醫診斷學常見的概念；掌握中醫診斷的基本原則；熟悉中醫診斷的基本原理、主要內容。
2. 掌握得神、失神、假神、常色的和病色的特徵及其臨床意義；熟悉常見異常形體、姿態的表現，色澤變化及五色所主病證。
3. 掌握正常舌象的表現，異常舌象的表現及其一般臨床意義；熟悉舌的結構。
4. 掌握咳嗽、哮、喘、呃逆、噯氣、噴嚏、譫語等變化及其一般臨床意義；以及病理性氣味等變化及其臨床意義。
5. 掌握問診的內容，常見現在症的內容；熟悉問診注意事項。
6. 掌握寸口脈診的方法，正常脈象的特徵，常見脈象的特徵與臨床意義，相兼脈的結合與主病規律；熟悉脈診的原理及診脈的意義，脈象的生理變異，以及診婦人脈、診小兒脈的特殊性。
7. 熟悉按診的意義。
8. 掌握八綱辨證的概念 ，各綱證候的概念、一般證候表現及臨床類型；
9. 掌握病因、氣血津液辨證的概念、各自包括的證候；熟悉病因病性的意義；
10. 掌握各臟腑的病變範圍和病機特點，及各臟腑常見證的含義、臨床表現和病機；
11. 熟悉六經辨證、衛氣營血辨證、三焦辨證、經絡辨證的基本知識和方法；
12. 掌握中醫病案書寫通則。

（二）專業技能方面：
1. 掌握望神的具體步驟和能夠判斷常見異常形體、姿態的表現；
2. 掌握舌診的方法，能夠識別臨床常見的病理性舌象；
3. 能夠判斷呼吸、語言、嘔吐等聲音的高低、強弱、清濁以及病理氣味等變化；
4. 能夠運用問診方法進行病情資料的收集；
5. 掌握寸口脈診的方法，熟悉正常脈象及各種病理脈象的指下感覺特徵；
6. 掌握和熟練運用常用按診的手法；
7. 能夠運用八綱辨證對臨床病例進行辨證；
8. 能夠運用病因、氣血津液辨證對臨床病例進行辨證；
9. 能夠運用臟腑辨證對臨床典型病例進行辨證；
10. 能夠運用六經辨證、衛氣營血辨證、三焦辨證對臨床典型病例進行辨證；
11. 能夠按照常規格式書寫中醫門診病歷。

（三）共通能力方面
1. 增強溝通及人際技巧
2. 提高解難的分析力及判斷力

（四）態度/價值觀方面
1. 樹立追求更好和完善的人生態度。
2. 增強追求更精確的科學態度。

courses.description: Huang-Di-Nei-Jing (The Yellow Emperor’s Medicine Classic) is the earliest Chinese medical writing among those which are available today. It is the foundation of the theories of Chinese medicine and throughout the years, developments of Chinese medicine were based on Nei-Jing. This course elaborates on the origin of Nei-Jing and explains it’s concepts on life and diseases. There will also be in depth study of selected passages of this medical classic.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCME Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
１. 熟悉《內經》成書的不同說法，掌握不同方面的考證方法及其結果。
２. 透過學習《內經》的宇宙生成和生命起源假說，掌握《內經》的大自然觀。
３. 透過學習《內經》的疾病觀，掌握人與自然的關係和中醫學中的生理、病理和養生等方面的理論基礎。
４. 透過研習《內經》部分篇章，掌握個別篇章的中心內容，並培養學生對其他篇章的自學能力。

courses.description:
Fundamental Chinese Materia Medica is a course dealing with the medical properties and clinical applications of Chinese material medical. It is one of the fundamental courses of Chinese medicine. This course consists of two parts: The first part covers the theories of Chinese medical material and the second part is about the medical properties and applications of different medicines.

The application of Chinese material medical is based on Chinese medicine theories, with particular emphasis on the pattern differentiation of Chinese medicine. Result of modern pharmaceutical research will also be introduced so as to provide basic knowledge about Chinese medicine research for the students.

Besides lecture, other learning activities will also be included in this course, such as specimen observation, visiting Chinese material medical factory and processing Chinese medical material.

courses.description: As one of the most important classics in Chinese Medicine, Treatise on Exogenous Febrile Diseases (Shang Han Lun) focuses on the treatment of cold-attack disease and forms a recognition system with theory, therapy, formula and herbs, which is termed as theoretical system of treatment based on syndrome differentiation. Such thinking way and treatment system have played a great impact on the development of Chinese medicine in clinical treatment for thousands of years. By means of studying the original texts, students should learn to understand the method of syndrome differentiation, especially for the cold-attack disease and further to understand its important significance in clinical treatment, which will enable them to establish a solid foundation for the study of various clinical courses.

courses.description:
Pediatric massage therapy is a clinical treatment in traditional Chinese Medicine that is specifically designed for children. It is non-invasive and also demonstrates good therapeutic efficacy on different common pediatric diseases. Since children have their unique physiological and pathological features, many of the acupuncture points like linear points and planar points applied is specific for children. The manual manipulation of pediatric massage therapy, including operating frequency and duration, is also different from that of adult massage therapy. The operation procedures must be light, soft and steady. Specific multiple-style manipulations may be required in addition to the conventional single-style manipulation for pediatric massage therapy.
The objectives of the course are to appreciate the development and the features of the current clinical branches of pediatric massage therapy, and to understand the principles of the selection of acupuncture points and manual manipulation in different common pediatric diseases.
courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本課程後，期望學生能達到以下學習成果：

2、瞭解目前小兒推拿的發展與研究現狀；
3、掌握常用穴位的部位、功效和操作方法；
4、學會主要的單式手法；複式手法的具體操作方法；
5、能夠診斷和治療小兒發熱、感冒、咳嗽、腹瀉、便秘等常見病；
６、能夠利用小兒推拿方法進行預防和保健。

courses.description: “Surgery and Topical Diseases in Chinese Medicine” is one of the main clinical subjects and plays an important role in Chinese medicine. It is an art of healing using combined surgical and pharmacological approaches to treat many surgical and topical diseases under the holistic theories of Chinese medicine. This course will emphasize on the clinical diagnosis, treatment methods and surgical techniques used in Chinese medicine for the management of the common topical diseases. This course will provide a basis for the students to further their clinical, teaching or researching careers in Chinese medicine, and is the foundation for the students to become specialists in topical diseases. The courses of “Basic Concepts in Chinese Medicine”, “Methodologies of Diagnosis in Chinese Medicine”, “Principles of Chinese Medicines Application” and “Principles of Prescription in Chinese Medicine” are the prerequisites for this course.

courses.description: Clinical Practice Training is an important part of the TCM teaching. Through clinical practice, the students may improve deep learning of basic theory, and enhance the clinical knowledge and skills. The clinical practice training will last for one year and a half. The students will go to different training sites by stages in mainland and Hong Kong, and receive clinical training on various specialties of Chinese medicine, including internal medicine, surgery, gynecology, pediatric, acupuncture, surgery, bone setting, ophthalmology and otolaryngology, and dermatology. The students are anticipated to have the ability to appropriately treat the common diseases after completing the training.
courses.enrollment_requirement: For BCME and MCMED Majors only.
courses.learning_outcomes:
畢業實習是教學的主要組成部份，是培養學生獨立分析問題、解決問題能力的科學思維方法，鞏固和提高所學 基礎理論、臨床知識和技能，對學生進行綜合訓練的重要階段。畢業實習要求學生德、智、體全面發展，系統掌握中醫基礎理論和中醫臨床診療技能，並具有一定的現代醫學知識。

學生於內地中醫院進行為期38週之全科實習訓練，科目包括：內科、婦科、兒科，針灸、骨傷科、外科、急診及中藥房等等，要求學生在實習中，通過臨床實踐，進一步加深對所學理論的理解，更加深入地掌握以下的知識和能力﹕
1. 中醫學基礎理論和臨床醫學理論。
2. 中藥、方劑學基本理論知識。
3. 中醫臨床各科常見病証的臨床特點、辨證論治、診療技術和急、重症的處理原則
4. 與中醫學有關的現代科學技術和現代醫學的基本知識。
5. 養成良好醫德醫風，關心病人疾苦，責任心強，不缺勤，不早退，完成全期實習培訓。

courses.description: This course is one of the fundamental courses in Chinese medicine. Through the systematic introduction of the basic theories in Chinese medicine with topics like yin-yang, vital activities of the body, meridians, viscera and bowels, causes and mechanisms of diseases and methods of diagnosis, students will be able to master the philosophical thoughts of Chinese medicine, the basic theories on the human body and diseases, and the principles of health maintenance and treatment. 本課程屬於中醫專業的基礎課程。通過本課程的學習，學生應能：

1. 引述中醫理論體系的主要特點，並說出中醫學和中醫基礎理論的基本概念、其形成和發展簡況。
2. 明確精、氣、陰陽、五行的基本概念和主要內容及其在中醫學中的應用。
3. 講述氣血津液的基本概念、生成、傳輸及功能，及氣血津液之間的關係。
4. 指出藏象的基本概念和五臟、六腑和奇恒之府的分類法，說明五臟的主要功能、特性和各髒氣、血、陰、陽的涵義，指出六腑和奇恒之府的主要功能，及髒與髒、腑與腑和髒與腑的關係。

courses.description: Diagnostic Approaches in Chinese Medicine is a subject about the fundamental theories, basic knowledge and skills concerning how to collect clinical information, diagnose diseases and differentiate patterns based on the basic theories of Chinese medicine. This module acts as a bridge linking the fundamental theories and various clinical subjects in Chinese medicine, and thus remains as one of the key components within the framework of Chinese medicine's specialties. Through the studies of this course, the students will be able to master the basic theories, fundamental knowledge and skills concerning the four diagnostic methods in Chinese medicine including observation, olfaction and auscultation, inquiring and palpation. Upon the completion of the course, the students will be capable of making clinical diagnosis using common pattern differentiation methods encompassing eight rubrics, etiology & qi, blood and body fluids, visceral differentiations. In addition, the students will be familiar with six channels differentiation, wei-qi-ying-xue differentiation, sanjiao differentiation and meridian differentiation methods. Emphasis will be placed on the training students’ practical skills in four diagnostic methods, differentiating clinical patterns and writing clinical case notes, so that the course will lay a solid foundation for future studies of clinical subjects. The module Basic Concepts in Chinese Medicine is a prerequisite for this course.

courses.description: This course introduces basic biomedical sciences involving Anatomy, Physiology and Biochemistry to Chinese Medicine students. This course deals with the basic anatomy and physiology of various systems including the general physiology of humans, with an objective of enhancing the students' knowledge and understanding of how the body adapts physiologically to internal and external environmental changes. Topics include the physiological principles of normal cells, tissues and systems of the body. The course also provides knowledge of biochemistry of nutrients and nucleic acid and biochemical regulations which have clinical applications. This course is a prerequisite to Modern Medical Science I & II.

courses.learning_outcomes:
By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Anatomy:
1. Have an understanding of the primary parts of the body and their specific construction which aligned the execution of their functions.
2. Understand how different structures group together to form systems.
3. Understand how changes in these primary structures will lead to malfunction.
Physiology
1. Understand the physiological properties of cell, tissue, organ and system.
2. Describe with examples how homeostasis helps maintain physiological functions.
3. Recall the organization of the nervous system and state how autonomic nervous system affects body functions.
4. Explain how the special senses particularly those in the eyes and ears function in human.
5. Discuss how the circulatory system helps regulate blood perfusion in body tissues.
6. Summarize how some of the altered functions in the cardiovascular and pulmonary systems affect the body.
7. Summarize the roles of blood in hemostasis and immune defense.
8. Explain how the pulmonary system and blood transport oxygen to tissues and carbon dioxide from the tissues.
9. Recognize how a skeletal muscle contracts and recall the importance of neuromuscular transmission in a human body.
10. Summarize how the gastrointestinal system carries out the digestion and absorption of ingested food.
11. Explain the processes by how the kidneys regulate the body fluid volume and its composition.
12. Outline the roles of various hormones and understand the mechanisms of their secretions.
13. Understand the basic functions and hormonal control of the male and female reproductive system.
14. Recognize how a skeletal muscle contracts and recall the importance of neuromuscular transmission in a human body.
Biochemistry
1. Outline the absorption and regulation of nutrients.
2. Summarize how the gene regulation of cell which affected by drugs, especially by examples of Chinese Medicine
3. Describe with examples how biochemical regulation affect the whole human body
4. Understandthe roles and regulations of glucose and lipoproteinsin human body and relevance of them to diseases.
5. Understand basic principles and clinical applications of common methods in biochemistry.

courses.description:
This course is a fundamental course in Chinese medicine. The content consists of two parts. For the first part, through the systematic introduction of the basic theories of Chinese medicine with topics like yin-yang, vital activities of the body, meridians, viscera and bowels, causes and mechanisms of diseases and methods of diagnosis, students will be able to master the philosophical thoughts of Chinese medicine, the basic theories on the human body and diseases, and the principles of health maintenance and treatment. This course also explains the essence of pattern differentiation and treatment determination and concept of holism, which are the unique characteristics of Chinese medicine.
The second part of the course will discuss basic knowledge and skills concerning how to collect clinical information, diagnose diseases and differentiate patterns based on the basic theories of Chinese medicine. The students will be able to master the basic theories, fundamental knowledge and skills concerning the four diagnostic methods in Chinese medicine including observation, olfaction and auscultation, inquiring and palpation. Upon the completion of the course, the students will be capable of making clinical diagnosis using common pattern differentiation methods encompassing eight rubrics, etiology & qi, blood and body fluids, visceral differentiations. Emphasis will be placed on training students’ practical skills in four diagnostic methods, differentiating clinical patterns and writing clinical case notes so that the course will lay a solid foundation for future studies of clinical subjects.

courses.description:
The course requires students to complete two mandatory areas including thesis writing and placement.

Thesis writing aims to train students to gain the ability to conduct scientific research on Chinese medicines independently by integrating the theories, ideas, methodologies, and presentation skills learned from other courses. The students will be guided to complete their theses by following steps: (i) to conduct a literature search and review on a research topic of Chinese medicines; (ii) to make a hypothesis by identifying an unsolved question; (iii) to propose the experimental methodologies to test the hypothesis; (iv) to present the results and make the conclusion from the results. Students need to draft a research protocol at the end of course. They will continue their studies in the next semester and submit a research paper or review paper after attending BCME6330 “Research Methodologies and Thesis Writing in Chinese Medicine and Placement (II)”.

Students are also required to attend a placement scheme. During the period of the scheme, students will engage in on-site visits and be placed in research laboratories / Institute for Food and Drug Control / Chinese medicine herbal companies / proprietary Chinese medicine companies to perform duties under the guidance of field supervisors. The placement scheme will help students to broaden their views in the industry and deepen their understanding in the application of advanced technologies to research and development of CM drugs.

courses.description:
The course requires students to complete two mandatory areas including thesis writing and placement.

Based on the knowledge gained in BCME6329 “Research Methodologies and Thesis Writing in Chinese Medicine and Placement (I)”, students are expected to conduct an evidence-based research in Chinese medicine (CM). CM research stream includes literature review and experiment. Student needs to complete the thesis under the supervision and guidance of a supervisor.

The purpose of a thesis is to demonstrate the students’ ability to develop an in-depth knowledge of a selected research topic, to critically and systematically integrate different types of scientific evidences in CM studies, to employ appropriate methodology, statistics analysis and research skills, and to clearly present and discuss the conclusions as well as the knowledge and arguments that form the basis for these findings.

Each student is mandated to submit an essay of about 10,000 words to report the objective, method, result and discussion of his/her research and to present the content in an oral defense at the end of the semester.

Besides thesis writing, students are also required to participate in the placement scheme similar to BCME6329 for further understanding of application of advanced technologies to research and development of CM drugs.

7. 通過實習計劃拓寬對行業的視野及加深中藥藥物研發的理解。

courses.description: This course aims to provide a fundamental knowledge of acupuncture knowledge, which will enable the students to carry on the clinical studies and to practice acupuncture in the latter part of the Programme. This course comprises two parts: Meridians (Channels and Collaterals) and Acupoints. Part I will systematically introduce the components of meridian system, the physiology and pathology of meridians and their applications in the diagnosis and treatment in acupuncture practice. Part II will introduce the classification and function of acupoints, the local anatomical knowledge of main acupoints and the applications of commonly used acupoints. Particular emphasis will be placed on the study of the Specific Points including their modern research and clinical use.

courses.learning_outcomes:
完成本課程後，學生們將能達到以下的學習成果：
1. 瞭解經絡、腧穴現代研究概况；重點課題及成果。
2. 掌握十四經脈循行、病候特徵、起止、聯屬關係和重點俞穴的定位、功用主治、應用研究。
3. 掌握八種特定穴的經典意義、現代研究與應用。
4. 熟煉掌握約100個俞穴的定位、功能、主治、刺法、組方、研究、使用。
